                                   Resolution 2022-27
                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

 RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT FOR THE PAVING OF TIMBERLINE DR PAST VAIL
    DR INTERSECTION AND VAIL DR TO LOVELAND DR INTERSECTION

WHEREAS, Girdwood Valley Service Area (GVSA) Manager requested improvements to the Timberline Dr and Vail Drive T-
Interchange due to high cost of maintenance; and

WHEREAS, the cost of road maintenance has increased in general and the problem area is of significant use for the large
neighborhood; and

WHEREAS, the GVSA has completed pre-application for the Alaska Department of Transportation’s (DOT) Community
Transportation Program (CTP) Grant; and has been encouraged by DOT to complete the formal CTP application for the next round of
grant funding; and

WHEREAS, GVSA proposes to apply for $1.5 million in CTP funding, to be matched by local GVSA funding of $200,000, for a total
project cost of $1.7 million; and

WHEREAS, the current road maintenance contractor is an efficient and reasonable company who will be able to do the work
necessary to improve the intersection, and

WHEREAS, this action has been discussed and considered by the Girdwood Land Use Committee, which voted 11 in favor 0 opposed
and 3 abstaining to recommend this resolution at their December 12, 2022 regular meeting.

THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors supports the paving of Timberline Dr to Vail Dr intersection and up Vail Dr to
Loveland Dr intersection and supports an application for a Community Transportation Program grant of $1.5 million, matched
$200,000 in GVSA funding to achieve this goal.

PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 in favor and 0 opposed this 19th day of December 2022.





Jennifer Wingard                                           Attest
GBOS Roads and Utilities Supervisor
